targets=['a001857f8626374a8','a5d1351b450362ddc','a6057966d6eb8d895','ab821b430e21e5f62','a315699d20996dab9','ae80d3c72bdb757c4','acffcc72b761da1cf']
for a in targets:
    f='agent-%s.jsonl'%a
    for i,line in enumerate(open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'),1):
        if 'AudioPlayerPage' not in line: continue
        try: r=json.loads(line)

        m=r.get('message') or {}

            if b.get('type')!='tool_use': continue
            n=b.get('name'); inp=b.get('input') or {}

            print('%s:%s %s'%(a,i,r.get('timestamp')))
            print('   OLD:',o)
            print('   NEW:',w)
" 2>&1 | head -180
